# 1a: shelf skeleton

## Read first

- `CLAUDE.md`, [architecture.md](../architecture.md) sections Inside shelf, HTTP API, Security and Configuration, [decisions.md](../decisions.md).
- proxier, the source of the code to copy and trim: `cmd/proxier/main.go`, `internal/platform/platform.go` with `Open`, `Migrate` and `Serve`, `internal/platform/{config,obs,db,migrations,httpx,module}`, `internal/platform/db/dbtest`, `internal/platform/ui/ui.go`, `internal/platform/web/static.go`, `Dockerfile`, `Makefile`, `.air.toml`, `compose.yaml`, `.forgejo/workflows/ci.yaml`.

## Done when

- `go run ./cmd/shelf serve` starts with nothing but defaults, runs migrations, serves `/healthz` and the placeholder Vue app, and stops cleanly on SIGINT or SIGTERM.
- `shelf version`, `shelf healthcheck` and `shelf manage migrate up | down <module> | status` work.
- `make check`, `make lint`, `make web-check` and `docker build .` pass. The image runs as UID 10001 and answers `/healthz`.
- The CI workflow is in place; it runs once the Forgejo remote exists.
- Every checklist line has its test.

## Decisions

| Topic | Decision | Why |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Module | `github.com/tikhonp/shelf`, `go 1.27.3`. `main` imports `_ "time/tzdata"`. | The user's convention; the alpine image may lack zone files for some zones. |
| Commands | `main(){ os.Exit(run(os.Args[1:], os.Stdout, os.Stderr)) }` with `serve`, `manage migrate up \| down <module> \| status`, `healthcheck`, `version`. | proxier's shape, testable without a process. |
| Platform | Copy proxier's `config`, `obs`, `db`, `dbtest`, `migrations`, `httpx`, `module` and `platform.go`. Remove the vault, settings, events, notify, auth, access, i18n, templ UI and everything that imports them. | The same conventions with less code. |
| Config | Only the `SHELF_*` variables in architecture.md. `Load(getenv)` collects every problem and returns them with `errors.Join`. `Warnings()` lists valid but risky settings, such as a Telegram token without users. Values are never logged. | proxier's pattern. |
| Database | modernc SQLite, one write connection and a read pool of 4, the DSN pragmas from proxier's `db.go`, writes only through `DB.Write`. The file is `<SHELF_DATA_DIR>/shelf.db`. | proxier's pattern. |
| Migrations | goose provider per module with the version table `<module>_goose_db_version`. The platform module has no tables in 1a; the runner accepts a module without migrations. | Jobs tables arrive in 1b. |
| Umask | `serve` sets umask 022 first thing, in a unix-only file, with a comment saying the music folder must stay readable by Navidrome. | The permissions decision. |
| HTTP | Echo v5. Middleware order: trailing-slash removal, request ID, slog request log that logs `/healthz` only when it fails, recover, security headers, `http.NewCrossOriginProtection` on unsafe methods, a 1 MiB body limit. Errors under `/api` are JSON `{"error": "..."}`. `/healthz` answers GET and HEAD. | proxier's order; a JSON API. |
| Headers | CSP `default-src 'self'; img-src 'self' https://static.qobuz.com https://*.mzstatic.com data:; style-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; connect-src 'self'; font-src 'self'; frame-ancestors 'none'; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'self'`, plus `X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff` and `Referrer-Policy: no-referrer`. | Covers are the only outside resources. |
| UI embed | `internal/platform/ui` embeds `all:dist`. `dist/.keep` is committed and the rest of `dist` is ignored. GET paths outside `/api` return `index.html`; `/assets/*` gets `Cache-Control: public, max-age=31536000, immutable`; `index.html` gets `no-cache`. Without a build, `/` shows a short "UI not built" page. | Go compiles without a UI build. |
| Vue scaffold | `web/` with Vite, Vue 3, TypeScript, Vue Router, Pinia and Vitest. One page that says Music Shelf and shows the version from `GET /api/version`. `vite build` writes to `../internal/platform/ui/dist`, and the build script recreates `dist/.keep`. | The whole pipeline works from the first step; 1g replaces the page. |
| Version | `GET /api/version` answers `{"version"}`. ldflags set `obs.AppVersion` to `<ref>-<sha7>`. | Visible in the UI and the logs. |
| Dockerfile | `web`: `node:24-alpine` running `npm ci` and `npm run build`. `base`: `golang:1.27.3-alpine`. `dev`: air v1.67.4 and goose v3.29.0. `lint`: golangci-lint v2.15.0 and govulncheck v1.9.0. `build`: `CGO_ENABLED=0`, `-trimpath`, `-ldflags "-s -w -X …AppVersion"`. `prod`: `alpine:3.22` with `ca-certificates ffmpeg tzdata`, `COPY --from=ghcr.io/zhaarey/apple-music-downloader:0.1.4 /usr/local/bin/amdl /usr/local/bin/amdl`, the shelf binary, `/data` owned by 10001, `USER 10001:10001`, `VOLUME /data`, `EXPOSE 8080`, `ENTRYPOINT ["/usr/local/bin/shelf"]`, `CMD ["serve"]` and a Dozzle icon label. | The plan's runtime image. amdl is in from the start so 1e only wires it. |
| Make | `check` runs gofmt, vet and `test`. `test` runs `go test -race -gcflags='modernc.org/...=-race=false' ./...`. `lint` runs `docker build --target lint .`. `web-check` runs `npm --prefix web ci`, `vue-tsc`, Vitest and the build. Also `dev`, `build-image` and `manage ARGS=…`. | proxier's targets plus the web check. |
| Dev | `.air.toml` like proxier's without templ. `compose.yaml` runs the `dev` target with `.env`, port 8080, and volumes `.:/src`, `./data:/data`, `./music:/music`. `.env.example` lists every variable with its default commented out. | Hot reload. |
| CI | `.forgejo/workflows/ci.yaml` from proxier: `test`, `lint` and `web` jobs in parallel, then `image` on push only, logging in with `secrets.REGISTRY_TOKEN` and pushing `code.tikhonnnnn.com/tikhon/shelf` tagged with the SHA, `main` and `latest`, for `linux/amd64`. No `permissions:` blocks. | Forgejo ignores them. |

## Routes

| Route | Answer |
| --- | --- |
| `GET`, `HEAD /healthz` | 200 `ok` |
| `GET /api/version` | `{"version": "dev"}` |
| `GET /api/<anything else>` | 404 JSON |
| `GET /<anything else>` | `index.html`, or the placeholder page |

## Doc changes

- `CLAUDE.md`: the State line, Commands, Layout as built.
- `docs/architecture.md`: anything that changed.
- `docs/status.md`.

## Checklist

| Edge case | Test |
| --- | --- |
| No variables set: every default applies | `TestConfigDefaults` |
| Several bad values are all reported at once | `TestConfigReportsEveryProblem` |
| Bad duration, bool, int, URL and time zone values | `TestConfigRejectsBadValues` |
| Telegram token without users gives a warning | `TestConfigWarnsTelegramWithoutUsers` |
| Config is never printed, even with `%v` | `TestConfigHidesSecrets` |
| `/healthz` answers GET and HEAD | `TestHealthzAnswersGetAndHead` |
| Unknown `/api` path is a JSON 404 | `TestUnknownAPIPathIsJSON404` |
| Any other GET path returns `index.html` | `TestSPAFallback` |
| `/assets/*` is immutable, `index.html` is not cached | `TestCacheHeaders` |
| Without a UI build, `/` shows the placeholder | `TestMissingUIBuildShowsPlaceholder` |
| Every response has the CSP and the other headers | `TestSecurityHeaders` |
| A cross-origin POST is refused | `TestCrossOriginPostRefused` |
| A body over 1 MiB is refused | `TestBodyLimit` |
| `migrate status` works for a module without migrations | `TestMigrateModuleWithoutTables` |
| A failing migration keeps the previous schema and exits | `TestFailingMigrationKeepsSchema` |
| `version` prints the version | `TestVersionCommand` |
| `healthcheck` exits 0 when `/healthz` answers and 1 otherwise | `TestHealthcheckCommand` |
| `serve` stops within 15 seconds after the context ends | `TestServeStops` |
| `serve` sets umask 022 | `TestServeSetsUmask` |
| The Vue page shows the version | `App.test.ts` |
